generationInputs.prompt: A coral-pink surface serves as the backdrop for a still life composition. The central element is a large, red, hand-shaped lollipop oriented diagonally. The lollipop's "fingers" point towards the upper left, while its white stick extends to the lower right. White sans-serif text is printed on the red surface, reading "HOY" stacked over "TE DAN POR," which is above "DETROIT" in a larger font. Below "DETROIT" is the number "55" followed by a smaller, illegible line of text. To the left of the hand lollipop is a light blue speech bubble outlined in white. Inside, dark teal cursive text reads "Tu suerte dice...." A round, clear and white candy is situated in the upper right area. In the lower right, a round lollipop displays alternating radial stripes of white and purple. Each object casts a shadow towards the right and slightly downward, suggesting a light source originating from the upper left.
